About Me

I’m a mixing and mastering engineer based in Estonia, focused on rock and metal. I love working with heavy guitars, punchy drums and aggressive vocals, but what matters most to me is how everything comes together as a song. I want my mixes to sound powerful and clear while keeping the character of the original performance.

I also care about how a mix sounds outside the studio. I check my work on different listening systems, including everyday headphones and speakers, to hear how it holds up where people actually listen.

Each song calls for its own approach. I listen for what needs more impact, what needs space, and what already works.

A Note on Editing

My focus is mixing and mastering, not extensive audio editing.

Drum and audio editing: Minor corrections are fine, but extensive timing correction, drum editing, and performance cleanup are not included.

Vocal tuning: Manual vocal pitch correction is not offered.
